question: As per Human Development Index Ranking (2020), which country has highest life expectancy at birth (years)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hong Kong, China (SAR).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **As per Human Development Index Ranking (2020), Hong Kong, China (SAR) has the highest life expectancy at birth (years)**, which is **84.9 years**.84.9
 
• India has been positioned at 131 out of 189 countries and territories, according to Human Development Index report (2020).
 
• As per Human Development Index Ranking (2020), **India's life expectancy at birth (years) ****is 69.7 years.**
 
• According to all three Dimensions (Life expectancy, Access to knowledge, and standard of living) of HDI-2020, Norway (1st) topped the index, followed by Ireland (2nd), Switzerland (3rd), **Hong Kong (4th), **and Iceland (5th).
 
• The report is released by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Human Development Report has based on three Basic Dimensions:

 
 
• Life expectancy at birth (years) **SDG3**
 
• Access to knowledge/ Expected years of schooling (years).
 
• A decent standard of living./Gross national income (GNI) per capita 
 
 
 
• The HDI is the geometric mean of the previous three normalized indices given above.
 
• **Life expectancy at birth**
 
 
• It is defined as how long a newborn can expect to live on average.
